# =====================================================================
#  Tests for NS3D
#
#  Two tests, both on reproducible sphere-pack benchmark images (0 =
#  fluid, 1 = solid) generated by the gen_spheres tool into data/:
#
#   1. test_spheres        - 128^3, one algorithm (SIMPLEC), checks the
#                            full pipeline produces a valid permeability.
#   2. compare_algorithms  - 64^3, all four algorithms (SIMPLEC, SIMPLER,
#                            SIMPLERR, IDEAL), compares permeability,
#                            iteration count, wall-clock time and
#                            convergence (see tests/compare_algorithms.sh).
#
#  Build:  cmake --build . --target make_test_images   (produces data/*.vti)
#  Run:    ctest --output-on-failure
# =====================================================================

set(TEST_IMAGE_128 ${DATA_DIR}/spheres_128.vti)
set(TEST_IMAGE_64  ${DATA_DIR}/spheres_64.vti)

# --- build-time generation (idempotent) ------------------------------------
add_custom_target(make_test_images
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory ${DATA_DIR}
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:gen_spheres> ${TEST_IMAGE_128} 128 12 5
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:gen_spheres> ${TEST_IMAGE_64}  64 8 3
    DEPENDS gen_spheres
    COMMENT "Generating test sphere images: spheres_128.vti, spheres_64.vti"
)

# --- test 1: (re)generate the images --------------------------------------
# Kept as a test so that `ctest` is self-contained even if data/ was
# cleaned. Images are written to absolute paths (CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR/data).
add_test(NAME gen_spheres_image COMMAND gen_spheres ${TEST_IMAGE_128} 128 12 5)
add_test(NAME gen_spheres_image_64 COMMAND gen_spheres ${TEST_IMAGE_64} 64 8 3)
set_tests_properties(gen_spheres_image PROPERTIES
    FIXTURES_SETUP  images
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR})
set_tests_properties(gen_spheres_image_64 PROPERTIES
    FIXTURES_SETUP  images
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR})

# --- test 2: single-algorithm run on the 128^3 image ----------------------
# The config file references the image with a path relative to the repo
# root, so the working directory is set to CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR. The solver
# writes its INFO-/RES-/P-/V* outputs there (all git-ignored).
add_test(NAME test_spheres COMMAND NS3D ${TESTS_DIR}/test_spheres.ini)
set_tests_properties(test_spheres PROPERTIES
    FIXTURES_REQUIRED  images
    WORKING_DIRECTORY  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}
    # Require a physically sensible, non-zero Darcy permeability.
    PASS_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "Permeability K \\(m²\\): [1-9]")

# --- test 3: compare the four algorithms on the 64^3 image ----------------
# The script runs every algorithm with the same setup and prints a
# comparison table; it exits non-zero if any algorithm fails to produce a
# finite, positive permeability. OMP_NUM_THREADS is pinned to 4 so the
# timing comparison is fair.
add_test(NAME compare_algorithms
    COMMAND ${TESTS_DIR}/compare_algorithms.sh $<TARGET_FILE:NS3D> ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR} ${TESTS_DIR}/compare_algorithms.ini)
set_tests_properties(compare_algorithms PROPERTIES
    FIXTURES_REQUIRED  images
    WORKING_DIRECTORY  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}
    ENVIRONMENT        "OMP_NUM_THREADS=4"
    # The table header + four method rows must be present.
    PASS_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "SIMPLEC.*SIMPLER.*SIMPLERR.*IDEAL")
